summary: Iteration 2 (performance optimization + dynamic spacing note) FULLY VERIFIED. All 16 backend pytest cases pass (9 prior + 7 new). New tests cover: verification object schema, dynamic spacing field for spacing 0.3 and 1.0 (both PASS, minDistance >= configured spacing, violatingPairs=0, method='shapely-polygon-distance'), correctness @ n=20/50/100 (100% placed, zero overlaps via Shapely polygon.distance >= 0.3, within media bounds), determinism including candidatesTested, benchmark 20/50/100 all placed with 0 failed. Direct /api/benchmark call reproduced the exact baseline numbers from the handoff note: n=20 util=60.6566 usedH=54.9292 cand=19136 (0.44s); n=50 util=70.2398 usedH=130.2493 cand=166757 (3.85s); n=100 util=72.4274 usedH=239.2758 cand=645308 (14.63s). Numbers are byte-identical to baseline -> optimization preserved behavior. Frontend Playwright E2E: generate->nest with spacing 0.3 renders note 'Required >= 0.30 cm', PASS verdict, minDistance 0.3000, 0/190 violations, 20 nested polygons; changing input-spacing to 1.0 and re-nesting updates note to 'Required >= 1.00 cm' with minDistance 1.0000 and PASS; no occurrence of hardcoded '0.38'. Debug mode toggle works (bbox + candidate overlays render).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still imports/initializes MongoDB client that is unused by any route - dead code (noted in iter 1, still present).
verify_spacing is O(n^2) pair iteration in Python; for n=100 that's 4950 Shapely distance calls on top of placement, measurable overhead. Fine for V0.1 but consider STRtree-based pruning for V0.2.
No HTTP-level validation errors for payload shape mismatches beyond FastAPI defaults; acceptable for prototype.
